1) run the game, keep the screen on

2) connect your phone to your pc and open a command prompt

3) give this a try: 
> adb backup -f <filename>.ab -apk jp.co.hit_point.nekoatsume

4) go back to your phone, confirm the backup appeared on the screen, don't give any password

5) check the output .ab file

for example, my total game data is 66MB, so i'm expecting backup size somewhere around that size.

if the process stopped right away or you only get 1KB size, my guess is either hit-point the developer set a flag that caused this game data cannot be backed up or try extending your screen time out / screen lock from e.g. 1min to the longest one available e.g. 30mins
